title: Normalized sum of correlated sign vectors
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$ and a pair $(x,y)$ of sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$, define their normalized correlated pair sum to be the normalized sum of correlated sign vectors obtained by reindexing the coordinates of $(x,y)$ into paired coordinates. The result lies in the two-dimensional Euclidean plane.
hypotheses_covered: A pair of sign vectors of length $n$
caveat: The snippet omits the definitions of the coordinate reindexing and normalized correlated sign-vector sum, so their precise constructions cannot be spelled out from the supplied material.
